text:
laura_pm: Heads up — pilot customer (Navis) is asking for a 'soft floor' commit + effectively unlimited burst credits with rollover. Need packaging decision by EOW.

mike_sales: They want two things: 1) $50k/month committed floor, 2) overage capped so they don't pay more than ~2x list during surges. Also asked for priority routing to reduce tail latency.

arjun_finance: We can't do unlimited burst at 2x without financial guardrails. Suggestion: a soft floor with a defined burst pool (e.g., 1.5x of typical), explicit overage rate (2.5x), and a hard cap after approvals. Need to model cash flow impact.

sophie_legal: Any exception needs metric-based limits and termination/triggers in the annex. Draft language idea: "surge credits" granted up to X tokens/month; once exceeded, excess billed at overage rate and subject to review. Also include a minimum term to avoid churn risk.

kevin_eng: From infra POV, priority routing + ad hoc burst pool adds complexity. We can implement a per-tenant token-bucket for priority lane, but it requires: a) admission control, b) observability for burst usage, c) fallback policy. Estimate ~2 sprints for safe rollout + canary. No cross-tenant KV cache sharing.

laura_pm: Proposed product packaging (first pass): "Pilot Plus" tier — $50k/month commit, includes burst allowance = 1.5x baseline usage, 25% rollover of unused burst for next month, priority lane (soft priority; best-effort), SLA 99.9. If usage > burst allowance, overage billed @2.5x. Pilot term 3 months, but finance wants 6 months minimum for revenue protection. Thoughts?

mike_sales: Language tweak: call them "surge credits" and show example billing. Customer wants predictability; we must show concrete examples in sales doc.

arjun_finance: Example calc snippet for the sales doc (please show to customer):
```
Baseline = 1M tokens
Included burst = 1.5M tokens
If usage = 3M tokens -> overage = 3M - 1.5M = 1.5M tokens billed @ 2.5x
```
That makes the math explicit. Also: require a 6-month minimum or an early-termination fee. Add retroactive reprice clause if 90-day avg > 3x baseline.

sophie_legal: I'll draft the annex with: 1) surge credits definition, 2) hard cap after manual approval, 3) term and ET fees, 4) metric thresholds for rollback. Need security and product signoff.

kevin_eng: Security confirm: no shared cache across tenants; priority lane implemented via isolated token-bucket + queued requests. Needs a small feature flag and canary. I'll put a PR on Tuesday and a simple dashboard for burst consumption.

laura_pm: Action items — Sophie: contract annex draft (Wed); Kevin: scope + PR (Tue); Arjun: P&L modeling and 6-month min impacts (Thu); Mike: customer-facing example doc + acceptance criteria (Thu). Review sync Fri 10am.

mike_sales: I'll get Navis to sign off on the example numbers before Fri. :thumbsup:

arjun_finance: If pilot grows faster than expected we should auto-trigger a pricing review — suggest internal alert at 60% of hard cap.

sophie_legal: noted. I'll include approval workflow language.

laura_pm: Cool — keeping this lightweight for pilot, but gating GA on engineering metrics + finance signoff. Thanks everyone.
